"Create a 3D game inspired by Paris Freestyle with a new level, one new mechanic, and a fresh challenge.
Create a polished 3D first-person military campaign game for Android.

GAME TITLE: SHADOW PROTOCOL

GENRE:
Cinematic modern military FPS, inspired by classic tactical military shooters.

VISUAL STYLE:
Realistic military environments, detailed weapons, atmospheric lighting, explosions, smoke, cinematic transitions and immersive sound.

PLAYER:
- First-person camera.
- Smooth movement and mouse-look style touch aiming.
- Mobile joystick on the left.
- Aim, fire, reload, crouch and jump buttons on the right.
- Adjustable sensitivity.

GAME SYSTEMS:
- Weapon switching and reloading.
- Player health and damage feedback.
- Enemy AI with basic cover-seeking and awareness.
- Friendly squad companions.
- Mission objectives and checkpoints.
- Pause menu and settings.
- Mission completion screen.

CAMPAIGN:
Create an original six-mission story about an elite international task force investigating a fictional global threat.

Each mission should have:
- A unique environment.
- A clear objective.
- Squad dialogue.
- Enemy encounters.
- A beginning and ending.
- A cinematic transition to the next mission.

IMPORTANT:
First create one complete playable mission as a vertical slice. Make sure movement, camera, shooting, mobile controls, enemy AI and objectives actually work before expanding the campaign.

Do not create decorative buttons that do nothing.
Prioritize stable performance on Android.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a polished, playable Android-friendly first-person military campaign game titled **SHADOW PROTOCOL**, beginning with one complete vertical-slice mission.
- Validate runtime and mobile controls, and save and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot.

- Include first-person movement and aiming, mobile joystick/actions, sensitivity settings, shooting/reloading, health feedback, enemy AI, squad companion, objectives, pause/settings, and mission completion.

- Avoid clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them when finished.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a browser-based Three.js FPS using Three.js 0.169.0 from jsDelivr.

1. Exercise mission controls and objective progression through relay interaction and completion; fix any issues.
2. Validate mobile layout and touch interactions in a mobile-sized browser view.
3. Capture/inspect a current small JPEG after any remaining changes and summarize verification.
4. Preserve the current uncommitted changes.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Three.js scene and gameplay implementation.
- `index.html`: Game screens, HUD, and mobile controls.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.

- Only mission 1 is playable; missions 2–6 are dossier entries marked locked.

## Objective
- Build a polished, playable Android-friendly first-person campaign game, **SHADOW PROTOCOL**, with one complete vertical-slice mission.
- Validate gameplay, mobile controls, and save a current JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Include movement and aiming, mobile joystick/actions, sensitivity settings, shooting/reloading, health feedback, enemy AI, squad support, objectives, pause/settings, and mission completion/failure.
- Establish an original six-mission story; only mission 1 is playable, with missions 2–6 locked.
- Keep controls functional and prioritize stable Android performance.
- Avoid clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them when finished.

## Decisions
- Implement as a browser-based Three.js FPS using Three.js 0.169.0 from jsDelivr.
- Mission 1 is **Operation Blackwater / Blackwater Signal**, featuring a coastal relay, five hostiles, and **Echo Pulse**.
- Campaign dossier lists six operations; missions 2–6 are locked.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the game UI and gameplay systems across `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`.
- `node --check game.js` passes; mission deployment, Echo Pulse, pause/settings, sensitivity adjustment, and resume were browser-tested.
- Mobile viewport test confirms joystick/look zone and action controls are visible and Echo Pulse responds.
